latest_release.name: 2026.10.1 : Bug Fix Release
latest_release.body: > ⚠️ **Timestamps include milliseconds.** On PostgreSQL and SQLite, date and time values in API responses, webhook payloads and CSV exports now include milliseconds (`12:34:56.000+00:00`). Check integrations that read dates in a fixed format. > **MCP lists every tool.** The MCP server at `/mcp` now lists every tool. If Windsurf or VS Code Copilot shows too many tools, connect it again with the `/mcp-discovery` URL. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/mcp#clients-that-cap-the-tool-list) > **Password changes sign out your apps.** Changing your password deletes your API tokens and disconnects apps you authorized with OAuth. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/account-settings/api-tokens#password-changes-delete-your-tokens) ## Improvements - **Classic apps on phones** - Published classic apps fit phone screens, including the sidebar, toolbars, record forms, dashboard groups and pivot widgets. - **Group by more field types** - Classic app pages group by Links, Formula, Lookup, Rollup and link count fields, and List widgets get a group by setting. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/classic-apps/layouts/table#grid) - **Resize columns in classic apps** - Drag a column edge in a List widget to resize it. Builders save the width for everyone. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/classic-apps/layouts/table#list) - **Open records from view widgets** - Calendar, Timeline and Gantt widgets on a dashboard can open a record when you click it. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/classic-apps/layouts/dashboard#configuring-widgets) - **Hide widget titles** - Data, chart and number widgets in a classic app have a *Show title* switch. - **Button visibility by role** - Page buttons in a classic app can show only to the roles you choose. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/classic-apps/elements#buttons) - **Reorder user filter tabs** - Builders drag user filter tabs into a new order. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/classic-apps/elements#user-filters) - **Sort Single Select by option order** - A sort on a Single Select field can follow the order of its options instead of A to Z. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/product/tables/table-operations/sort#sort-a-single-select-field-by-option-order) - **Sign out of other devices** - *Account* > *Security* signs you out everywhere except the current browser on NocoDB Cloud. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/product/account-settings/authentication/sign-out-other-devices) - **Templates on Home** - Home and the *New project* page show a template gallery on NocoDB Cloud, and projects built with AI start with a few sample records. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/product/projects/create-project#from-template) - **Greek** - NocoDB is now available in Greek. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/product/account-settings/language) - **MCP rate limits** - MCP has its own limit per account. A client that goes over it is told how long to wait. - **MCP connected apps** - The list of connected apps shows when each app was last used. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/mcp/connections#managing-and-removing-access) - **OAuth consent screen** - The consent screen shows where you will be sent and warns when an app is not verified by NocoDB. - **Live updates** - Gallery, Kanban, Map, dashboards and classic app record review refresh in place when collaborators edit. ## What's Fixed - **Workflows and webhooks** - *When record updated* workflows and update webhooks run when records are linked or unlinked through the API, paste or a foreign key change. [Learn more](https://docs.nocodb.com/docs/workflows/nodes/trigger-nodes/record-updated#how-it-works) - **Formulas** - Formulas with `?` inside text evaluate, Checkbox values act as 1 and 0 in PostgreSQL formulas, and XOR results c
